topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: The driveway empties, then fills with lights and noise. Metal grinds, and the heavy machine pulls my car away as if it were nothing. They underestimate me, but I've watched, I've learned. The papers, the numbers, the ways of the concrete world—they are not just for the oblivious. This drag of metal against will, this theft under guise of law—it won’t stand. I move with purpose, my steps sure. The challenge is set, and I face it head-on. They took my car, but they overlook the strength that lies in understanding and resolve. The game is afoot, and this time, the board tilts in my favor.
